findings.title: Missing re-check after acquiring write lock causes redundant asset loading
findings.body: After acquiring the write lock at line 48, the code does not re-check whether entryPointAssetsCache has been populated by another goroutine. In a non-Dev environment, if multiple requests arrive concurrently when the cache is nil, the first goroutine acquires the lock and begins loading. The others block on RLock until the first releases, then one of them acquires the write lock (since ret is still nil from their earlier RLock snapshot) and repeats the full loading process. This can lead to unnecessary file reads or CDN requests under startup concurrency. Adding a re-check inside the write lock (e.g., `if cfg.Env != setting.Dev && entryPointAssetsCache != nil { return entryPointAssetsCache, nil }`) would prevent redundant work.

findings.title: Typo in error message
findings.body: The error message says "asssets-manifest" instead of "assets-manifest". This is a pre-existing typo but it appears in an error string that could be shown to users; correcting it improves clarity.
